import openpyxl, os
from copy import copy
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(os.environ['OUT_XLSX'])
ws = wb.active
ws['G1'] = 'Test'
for r in range(2, 17):
    f = ws.cell(row=r, column=6)
    g = ws.cell(row=r, column=7)
    g.value = 'X' if (f.value == 'Covid Test') else None
    g.font = copy(f.font)
    g.fill = copy(f.fill)
    g.border = copy(f.border)
    g.alignment = copy(f.alignment)
    g.number_format = f.number_format
wb.save(os.environ['OUT_XLSX'])
print('done')
